secrets_info.title: How Secrets Flow
secrets_info.subtitle: Zero credentials in code: delivered at runtime by the External Secrets Operator from Secrets Manager
secrets_info.step1: ClusterSecretStore: the External Secrets Operator authenticates with Secrets Manager via authn-jwt/eks-latam using the pod's Kubernetes service account JWT
secrets_info.step2: ExternalSecret maps Secrets Manager paths to a K8s Secret:
secrets_info.step4: Deployment mounts the secret as environment variables via envFrom.secretRef
secrets_info.step5: App reads DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASS from env: no Secrets Manager SDK, no file reads
